name: vsgrok
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code powered by xAI Grok: streaming chat, inline completions, agent mode with reviewed edits, commit messages and quick fixes.

commands.title: Ask Grok About the Failed Terminal Command

vsgrok.model.description: xAI model id used for chat, commands and agent mode. Pick from the chat header dropdown or 'VSGrok: Select Model' (list comes live from GET {baseUrl}/models).

enumDescriptions: xAI Responses API (POST /v1/responses): server-side history, reasoning summaries, Web/X Search, Code Execution.
Legacy Chat Completions API (POST /v1/chat/completions). Fallback only: no server-side tools or citations.
vsgrok.api.markdownDescription: Which xAI API chat, commands and agent mode use. See [Migrating to Responses API](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/text/comparison). Inline completions always use Chat Completions (short stateless requests).

vsgrok.responses.store.markdownDescription: Store responses on xAI (30 days) and continue chats with `previous_response_id` so only new turns are sent. When off, `store: false` is sent and VSGrok resends the full local history (including encrypted reasoning) each turn.

vsgrok.responses.compactAtTokens.markdownDescription: When a chat's input reaches this many tokens, compact it with `POST /v1/responses/compact` before the next turn ([Context Compaction](https://docs.x.ai/developers/advanced-api-usage/context-compaction)). 0 disables.

vsgrok.tools.webSearch.markdownDescription: Let Grok use xAI's server-side [Web Search](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/web-search) tool (billed per call by xAI). Also toggled from the chat header. Responses API only.

vsgrok.tools.xSearch.markdownDescription: Let Grok use xAI's server-side [X Search](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/x-search) tool (billed per fetched item). Also toggled from the chat header. Responses API only.

vsgrok.tools.codeExecution.markdownDescription: Opt in to xAI's server-side [Code Execution](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/code-execution) tool (`code_interpreter`; runs Python in xAI's sandbox, not on your machine). Responses API only.

vsgrok.context.maxFileChars.description: Maximum characters of an attached file or selection sent as chat context (grok-4.7 has a 500k-token window).

vsgrok.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the xAI OpenAI-compatible API.

vsgrok.maxTokens.description: Maximum visible output tokens per response (max_output_tokens on the Responses API, max_tokens on Chat Completions).

vsgrok.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: `reasoning_effort` for Grok reasoning models (grok-4.5+; `xhigh` on grok-4.6+). `default` omits it (xAI default is `high`). `low` is faster for agentic tool use. Not applied to inline completions. See [xAI reasoning docs](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/text/reasoning).

vsgrok.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Abort a request if no data arrives for this many seconds.

vsgrok.agent.enabledByDefault.description: Start chats with Agent on: Grok may also propose edits and request terminal commands; each needs Approve on an in-chat card. Read-only workspace tools are always available.

vsgrok.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per agent request.

vsgrok.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Show Grok ghost-text completions while typing.

vsgrok.inlineCompletions.debounceMs.description: Delay after typing before requesting a completion.

vsgrok.inlineCompletions.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens for an inline completion.

vsgrok.checkForUpdates.markdownDescription: Check [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/GalacticOrgOfDev/VSGrok/releases) for a newer VSGrok once a day and offer an in-chat **Update now** card (downloads the release `.vsix` and installs it). Run **VSGrok: Check for Updates** anytime.

enumDescriptions: Deep-space Grok look with starfield and cosmic accents.
vsgrok.theme.description: Chat panel appearance. High-contrast themes always use VS Code colors.

vsgrok.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Record a local diagnostics log (request timing, retries, error kinds, tool names, index stats). Never records your API key, prompts, responses or file contents. Stays on this machine; **VSGrok: Copy Diagnostics** copies it for a bug report.

vsgrok.index.enabled.markdownDescription: Build a local workspace index (file paths, symbol outlines, BM25 lexical search) for the `find_relevant_files` tool. Runs entirely on your machine; no embedding service. Respects `.gitignore`; never indexes `.env` or credential files.

vsgrok.index.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra glob patterns to keep out of the workspace index, e.g. `["**/fixtures/**", "data/**"]`.

vsgrok.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum files in the workspace index (shallowest paths first). Larger repos are capped.

vsgrok.testCommand.markdownDescription: Command `run_tests` uses (e.g. `pnpm test`, `pytest -q`). Empty = detect from package.json scripts, pytest config, go.mod or Cargo.toml. Always shown on an approval card before it runs. Ignored in Restricted Mode; a value set by the workspace is labelled as such on the card.

vsgrok.checks.offerAfterEdits.markdownDescription: After the agent edits files, show a **Re-run checks** button under its reply (not shown when the Plan applied card already offers it).

vsgrok.inlineEdit.enabled.description: Enable Grok inline edit (Ctrl+I / Cmd+I in the editor). Ctrl+I yields to another inline-chat provider (e.g. Copilot) when one is installed; rebind vsgrok.inlineEdit to use it then.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every edit and command (default).
Run task only: auto-approve creates/edits of workspace files (not deletes, renames, flagged files like package.json/CI/.vscode, or symlinks out of the workspace).
Run task only: also auto-approve commands that exactly match vsgrok.agent.commandAllowlist.
vsgrok.agent.autoApprove.markdownDescription: Auto-approval for **Run task** only (normal chat always asks). Read from your user settings only; workspace settings are ignored. Deletes, renames, non-allowlisted commands and files outside the workspace always ask in the chat.

vsgrok.agent.commandAllowlist.markdownDescription: Commands **Run task** may run without asking when `vsgrok.agent.autoApprove` is `editsAndCommands`. Exact match only (whitespace collapsed); anything with shell metacharacters (`; & | $ > <` …) always asks. User settings only.

vsgrok.agent.task.maxSteps.description: Run task: maximum tool rounds before Grok must stop and summarise.

vsgrok.agent.task.maxTokens.description: Run task: stop after this many input+output tokens (0 = no limit).

vsgrok.agent.task.maxCostUsd.description: Run task: stop once the cost reported by xAI reaches this many US dollars (0 = no limit; ignored when xAI reports no cost).

vsgrok.history.enabled.markdownDescription: Save chats on this machine (VS Code global storage) after each answer so they can be searched, reopened, renamed, deleted and exported. API keys are never saved; text is redacted for secret-looking tokens and images are not kept. Turning this off stops saving; existing chats stay until deleted.

vsgrok.history.saveContext.markdownDescription: Also save each chat's full model context (attached file text, tool outputs, git diffs, terminal output, encrypted reasoning) so a reopened chat resumes exactly. Off by default: only the visible transcript is saved and reopened chats are rebuilt from it.

vsgrok.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP servers whose tools Grok may use when Agent is on (every call asks in the chat unless you tick **Always allow** for that tool). Map of name → `{ "command", "args", "env", "cwd" }` (stdio) or `{ "url", "headers" }` (streamable HTTP; https, or http on localhost). `"disabled": true` skips one. A workspace can add servers in `.vscode/vsgrok-mcp.json` (`{ "servers": { … } }`), used only in trusted workspaces. See *VSGrok: MCP Servers* for status.

vsgrok.terminalHelper.enabled.markdownDescription: When a terminal command fails (non-zero exit, via shell integration), show a subtle **Ask Grok** item in the status bar. One click sends the command, exit code and output tail to chat for a diagnosis and a proposed fix through the approval card. No notifications.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.mjs --production
scripts.test:integration: node esbuild.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.int.json && node out-int/test-int/runTest.js
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode VSGrok does not run git, ignores the project's VSGrok.md / .vsgrok/rules.md and .vscode/vsgrok-mcp.json, and still never reads .env or credential files. Agent edits and commands always need your approval.
